name: The Genie Method
description: A 3-step pipeline for non-technical professionals to build complete apps and write full-length books with AI. Includes two skills: spec-to-scripts (app building via interview, technical spec, and module-by-module Claude Code scripts) and write-to-publish (book/document writing via interview, story bible, and chapter-by-chapter writing scripts with consistency checks). Written by a medical professional for doctors, lawyers, plumbers, trainers, and anyone who isn't a developer.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, `spec-to-scripts` (A 3-step pipeline for building complete apps with near-zero errors: (1) deep interview to understand the app, (2)…), `write-to-publish` (A 3-step pipeline for writing complete books, reports, and long-form documents with consistency and quality: (1) deep interview…).

Installs with `claude plugin install the-genie-method@claude-community` from `jackatzmon/genie-method`.
